# Separate context regressions from later exposed errors

The supplied Bug 2073142 history attributes the broken Details caller context to Bug 1787094, commit bbf4061b4193c7c5a0d747fa12bfc8aff71ddea9, which loaded imip-bar.js in aboutMessage.xhtml. Bug 1834952, commit 8b86548bbcfcbb0bd8425f34ea0572a7f6f787b4, later supplied the missing editing function and exposed the null-tabmail TypeError. Bug 1860330 moved the handler into calItipUtils.sys.mjs while retaining the caller window. When investigating this stack, distinguish the context change, the fix that exposed the next failure, and the later refactor; the module named in the stack alone does not identify the origin. This remains a provisional source-based attribution, without a binary regression range.

Scope: Calendar Details regression attribution.
